_readme: The room library's fixed vocabulary. Every other library file is checked against it
(python -m worldgen library check). Add a category, role, purpose or family here first,
then use it. See ROOM_LIBRARY_DESIGN.md and library/AUTHORING.md.

sizeBands._readme: interior area in cells (the room minus its wall ring): tiny <12, small 12-24, medium 25-48, large 49+

categories.bed: anything people sleep on: pallets, bedrolls, beds, bunks, hammocks, cots, sleep pods
categories.crib: a cot or cradle for a baby
categories.chair: a seat for one with a back
categories.bench: a seat for several without upholstery, pews included
categories.sofa: an upholstered seat for several, booths and couches
categories.table: dining, kitchen, round, long and side tables
categories.nightstand: a small table or cabinet beside a bed
categories.desk: a writing, office, school or work desk
categories.counter: a fixed counter: shop, bar, kitchen worktop, reception
categories.display: a display case, cabinet or stand for goods or exhibits
categories.shelf: open shelving: bookcases, utility, warehouse and goods shelves
categories.cabinet: closed storage: cupboards, sideboards, dressers, filing and medicine cabinets
categories.wardrobe: a tall cabinet or armoire for clothes
categories.chest: a lidded chest, trunk or strongbox
categories.rack: racks for coats, clothes, weapons, tools, wine or goods
categories.pallet: stacked goods on a pallet or skid
categories.hearth: an open fire for heat and light: fireplace, brazier, fire pit, fire barrel
categories.stove: a cooking range or stove, from a pot over coals to a galley unit
categories.fridge: a cold store: icebox, fridge, freezer, cooler
categories.appliance: a household or office machine that is not a stove or fridge: washer, dryer, coffee machine, microwave, water heater, fan
categories.bath: a bathtub, wash tub or shower
categories.toilet: a chamber pot, privy seat or toilet
categories.light: a free-standing light: candle stand, torch stand, lamp, lantern
categories.decor: other floor decor: screens, mirrors, globes, suits of armour, aquariums, fountains
categories.board: a blackboard, whiteboard, notice board or map table board
categories.lectern: a lectern, pulpit or reading stand
categories.altar: an altar, shrine or offering table
categories.religious: other religious furniture: prayer mats, font, reliquary
categories.instrument: a musical instrument big enough to place: piano, organ, harp, drum kit
categories.game: a game table or machine: chess, cards, billiards, arcade, pinball, roulette
categories.screen: a television, holo-projector or display wall unit
categories.radio: a radio, gramophone, jukebox or speaker
categories.computer: a computer, terminal or workstation console
categories.console: a control console: ship helm, station controls, security desk console
categories.server: a server rack, data core or switchboard
categories.workbench: a general workbench or work table
categories.forge: a forge, smelter or furnace for metalwork
categories.kiln: a kiln for pottery or glass
categories.loom: a loom, spinning wheel or sewing machine
categories.lathe: a lathe, saw bench, drill press or other machine tool
categories.press: a printing, cider or oil press
categories.still: a still, brewing vat or fermenting tun
categories.mill: a hand mill, quern or grinder
categories.butcher: a butcher's block or meat hook rail
categories.alchemy: an alchemy bench or apothecary's station
categories.lab: a laboratory bench, fume hood or analysis station
categories.medical: medical furniture: exam table, operating table, IV stand, privacy curtain, autoclave
categories.cell_bed: a cell bunk or prison cot fixed to the wall
categories.gym: exercise equipment: weights bench, treadmill, punch bag, training dummy
categories.hydroponics: a hydroponic tray, grow bed or planting table
categories.feed: animal feed and stalls: hay bales, troughs, mangers
categories.firewood: a stack of firewood or fuel
categories.security: security fixtures: detectors, turnstiles, gun lockers
categories.utility: ladders, mop buckets, generators, pipes and other building plant

roles.sleep.couple: a double bed for one couple (count couples)
roles.sleep.child: a cot or small bed for a child
roles.bedside: a nightstand or small table beside a bed
roles.storage.big: a large closed store: wardrobe, cupboard, dresser
roles.storage.small: a small store: chest, footlocker, crate, basket
roles.storage.bulk: bulk goods: barrels, sacks, crates, pallets
roles.seat.lounge: a comfortable seat: armchair, sofa, booth
roles.seat.state: a throne or seat of honour
roles.table.small: a side, coffee or small round table
roles.counter.serve: a counter staff stand behind: bar, shop counter, reception
roles.heat: a hearth, fireplace, brazier or heater
roles.cook: a stove, range or galley unit
roles.laundry.wash: a wash tub or washing machine
roles.light.big: a large light: candelabrum, standing lamp, light tower
roles.decor.floor: a rug, plant, statue or other floor decor
roles.decor.feature: a centrepiece: statue, fountain, aquarium, globe
roles.work.secondary: a second work station or machine
roles.work.tool: tool storage for the work: tool rack, tool chest
roles.work.material: raw material for the work: timber, ore, cloth, firewood
roles.lectern: a lectern, pulpit or speaker's stand
roles.devotion: other devotional furniture: prayer mat, font, candle stand
roles.server: a server rack or data core
roles.med.supply: a medicine cabinet, IV stand or autoclave
roles.grow: a grow bed, planter or hydroponic tray
roles.coat: a coat rack or hooks stand
roles.weapons: a weapon rack or gun locker
roles.utility: building plant: ladder, generator, mop bucket

families.bedroom: a room for one or a few people to sleep, singles
families.bedroom.master: a bedroom for one couple: a double bed
families.dormitory: many sleepers in rows: barracks, crew bunks, a hostel room
families.hut: a one-room home: a sleeping corner, a hearth, a table
families.dining: eating at tables, from a family dining room to a mess hall
families.common_room: sitting and gathering: living room, taproom, lounge, great hall
families.shop: goods on show and a counter
families.storage: goods stored: pantry, cellar, store room, warehouse bay
families.workshop: a trade's work stations: smithy, carpentry, tailor, fabricator bay
families.chapel: worship: altar and seats facing it
families.ward: the sick in beds: infirmary, hospital ward
families.clinic: treatment: an exam or operating table and supplies
families.control: a control room: ship's bridge, station ops, security office
families.guardroom: guards on duty: a table, weapon racks, bunks
families.passage: a way through: corridor, entrance hall, lobby, airlock

anchors._readme: Combine with +, e.g. wall:far+corner. far/side/near are relative to the room's main door.
anchors.row:<north|south|east|west|far|side|near: the count stands in a row along that wall
anchors.center: in the middle of the floor
anchors.beside:<slot id>: next to the piece in that slot
anchors.around:<slot id>: spread round the piece in that slot (chairs at a table)
anchors.symmetric: mirrored pairs (with beside:, e.g. nightstands either side of a bed)
